record.field: Automatizar UdM de compra según proveedor

# ============================================================ # Automation: vendor-specific UoM on PO lines # Model: purchase.order.line # Trigger: on create / update (product_id, product_uom, # product_qty, product_packaging_id) # Apply on: [("state", "in", ["draft", "sent", "purchase"]), # ("display_type", "=", False), ("product_id", "!=", False)] # Source: product.supplierinfo.x_studio_vendor_uom (custom) # product.supplierinfo.x_studio_transition (custom) # Rule 1: transition guard (draft/sent/purchase): a line already in # a transition UoM keeps the transition price, because Odoo # recomputes it from the standard vendor row on qty changes # Rule 2: standard vendor UoM (draft/sent only): apply vendor UoM, # drop packaging, set vendor price as-is # Skip: lines created by the transition button (context flag) # Chatter: one internal note per order # ============================================================ # ---- Constants ---- EDITABLE_STATES = ("draft", "sent") TRANSITION_STATES = ("draft", "sent", "purchase") NOTE_SUBTYPE = "mail.mt_note" NOTE_TITLE = "🔁 Ajuste automático de UdM de proveedor" VENDOR_UOM_FIELD = "x_studio_vendor_uom" TRANSITION_FIELD = "x_studio_transition" SKIP_CONTEXT_KEY = "skip_vendor_uom_rule" SET_VENDOR_PRICE = True # vendor price is expressed in the vendor UoM DEBUG = False # True = log every decision in the chatter PRICE_DIGITS = 6 notes_by_order = {} # order.id -> list of html lines orders_by_id = {} # order.id -> order record # Lines written by the transition button are left untouched target_lines = env["purchase.order.line"] if env.context.get(SKIP_CONTEXT_KEY) else records for line in target_lines: order = line.order_id product = line.product_id # Guard: only product lines of open orders if line.display_type or not product or order.state not in TRANSITION_STATES: continue if order.id not in notes_by_order: notes_by_order[order.id] = [] orders_by_id[order.id] = order notes = notes_by_order[order.id] order_date = order.date_order.date() if order.date_order else datetime.date.today() # ---- Rule 1: transition guard ---- transition = False for s in product.with_company(order.company_id).seller_ids: if not s[TRANSITION_FIELD] or s[VENDOR_UOM_FIELD] != line.product_uom: continue if s.partner_id.commercial_partner_id != order.partner_id.commercial_partner_id: continue if s.company_id and s.company_id != order.company_id: continue if s.product_id and s.product_id != product: continue transition = s break if transition: t_price = transition.price if transition.currency_id and transition.currency_id != order.currency_id: t_price = transition.currency_id._convert( t_price, order.currency_id, order.company_id, order_date) if float_compare(line.price_unit, t_price, precision_digits=PRICE_DIGITS) != 0: old_price = line.price_unit line.write({"price_unit": t_price}) notes.append("🔄 %s: precio de transición restaurado %s → %s (%s)." % ( product.display_name, old_price, t_price, line.product_uom.display_name)) elif DEBUG: notes.append("· %s: precio de transición correcto." % product.display_name) continue # ---- Rule 2: standard vendor UoM (only before confirmation) ---- if order.state not in EDITABLE_STATES: continue seller = product.with_company(order.company_id)._select_seller( partner_id=order.partner_id, quantity=line.product_qty, date=order_date, uom_id=line.product_uom, params={"order_id": order}, ) if not seller: if DEBUG: notes.append("· %s: sin proveedor aplicable." % product.display_name) continue # A transition row must never be the default seller (Odoo would price from it) if seller[TRANSITION_FIELD]: notes.append("⚠ %s: Odoo ha elegido la fila de transición de %s como proveedor por defecto. " "Colócala debajo de la fila estándar en la pestaña Compra." % ( product.display_name, seller.partner_id.display_name)) continue vendor_uom = seller[VENDOR_UOM_FIELD] # Rule applies only when vendor has its own UoM, different from purchase UoM if not vendor_uom or vendor_uom == product.uom_po_id: if DEBUG: notes.append("· %s: proveedor sin UdM propia o igual a la de compra." % product.display_name) continue # Different category would raise on quantity conversion if vendor_uom.category_id != product.uom_id.category_id: notes.append("⚠ %s: UdM proveedor %s no es de la categoría %s. No se modifica." % ( product.display_name, vendor_uom.display_name, product.uom_id.category_id.display_name)) continue vals = {} changes = [] if line.product_uom != vendor_uom: vals["product_uom"] = vendor_uom.id changes.append("UdM %s → %s" % (line.product_uom.display_name, vendor_uom.display_name)) if line.product_packaging_id: vals["product_packaging_id"] = False vals["product_packaging_qty"] = 0.0 changes.append("embalaje %s eliminado" % line.product_packaging_id.display_name) if SET_VENDOR_PRICE: vendor_price = seller.price if seller.currency_id and seller.currency_id != order.currency_id: vendor_price = seller.currency_id._convert( vendor_price, order.currency_id, order.company_id, order_date) uom_changing = "product_uom" in vals price_differs = float_compare( line.price_unit, vendor_price, precision_digits=PRICE_DIGITS) != 0 # Always set price when UoM changes: otherwise Odoo recomputes it # converting from uom_po_id, and the vendor price is already per vendor UoM if uom_changing or price_differs: vals["price_unit"] = vendor_price changes.append("precio %s → %s" % (line.price_unit, vendor_price)) if not vals: if DEBUG: notes.append("· %s: ya correcto." % product.display_name) continue # Single write: written fields are protected from recompute in this call line.write(vals) notes.append("✅ %s (proveedor %s): %s." % ( product.display_name, seller.partner_id.display_name, ", ".join(changes))) # ---- Chatter: one internal note per order ---- for order_id in notes_by_order: lines_html = notes_by_order[order_id] if lines_html: orders_by_id[order_id].message_post( body=NOTE_TITLE + "
" + "
".join(lines_html), body_is_html=True, subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE, )
